description: Prefix-only containment guards: the CVE-2025-53110 shape (allowedDirectories.some(dir => p.startsWith(dir))), a sandbox write checked with startsWith(path.resolve(root)), and a Python realpath(...).startswith(FILES_DIR). Each admits a sibling path that shares the prefix. VC117 also fires on the Python handler: the prefix-only guard beside it used to silence it.
